review_focus: The WHOLE candidate baseline..HEAD. It contains TWO milestones: DEV-LIFECYCLE-3B (driver: scripts/dev_workflow/**, tests/dev_workflow/**, docs/dev_workflow/DEV_LIFECYCLE_3B*, its config) which was reviewed in its own driver run and is a prerequisite, and UI-V2-POSTINT (everything else). Review UI-V2-POSTINT against AC-1..AC-10 of docs/ui_v2/postint/00_PLAN_AND_ACCEPTANCE.md; for the DEV-LIFECYCLE-3B part only confirm it is the reviewed prerequisite and that UI-V2-POSTINT does not change it

UIV2-F1 data integrity: no path lets an ordinary conversational message, typed or spoken, from any surface (Workspace, Companion, dashboard, voice) change an open Text Intelligence draft; explicit edits still work; a new document never silently discards the open draft (retention, Undo/Redo semantics, a new edit ends the way forward); open draft questions; dictation; the L-2 command contract; Core-only requests still go to Core

Classifier precision: text_intent anchoring (_anchored, _object_is_draft, _ANCHOR, _CORRECTION, draft_text overlap) must not route ordinary chat to the desk and must not drop legitimate revisions; look for counterexamples both ways
UIV2-F2: testing-only controls hidden for ordinary users; URI_UI_TESTING_TOOLS gate; no accepted feature removed

UIV2-F3: ScrollWhenShort/ShortIntrinsic correctness (intrinsics, nested scrolling, approval/confirmation cards and Stop reachable, draft toolbar reachable, no layout change at normal sizes); Brain pickers; composer row
UIV2-F4: companion_lunar.frag change keeps premultiplied alpha, true transparency and renderer identity; no extra pass; the shader pin change is limited to Lunar
Preservation and security: no approval or permission bypass, typed text never a decision, no protected path, no new dependency; URI_UI_VISUAL=living and the classic interface still reachable
user-facing work: every capability reachable and operable through the real URI Windows UI; discoverability, feedback, recovery, first-time and returning user
Performance: no expensive new effects (saveLayer, blur, extra shader passes, persistent timers)
